domain_policy.rule: worldprotocolacademy.mk is the primary institutional/public domain; sande@wpa.mk is retained as a direct WPA contact address and does not represent a separate institution.

zenodo_corpus.rule: Zenodo repository records are a separate WPA corpus and are not added to the 26 academic-publication count.

master_list.rule: External records and distinct external institutions are different metrics and must not be conflated.

public_nomenclature.council_80_rule: Use bounded workflow seats on general public surfaces; tactical-operational remains an internal architecture term and does not create autonomous institutional authority.

audio_video_creator_engine.canonical_name: WPA Audio Video Creator Engine v9

audio_media_engine.role: audio translation, editing, transcription and structuring

public_nomenclature.audio_naming_rule: The creator engine and the audio media engine are distinct tools; do not collapse them into one name merely because both work with media.

language_boundary_policy.legal_and_boundary_texts: Where practical, Macedonian and English legal, status, payment, privacy, accreditation and responsibility statements should be presented as clearly separated language blocks.

governance.public_claim_rule: Prefer evidence-backed, descriptive institutional language over unsupported best/world-class/number-one claims.

note: This file is the canonical machine-readable reference for public WPA facts shared across public surfaces. Historical documents may preserve older values as dated records. The 2026-09-07 audit review explicitly separates academic-publication counts from the Zenodo corpus, external records from distinct institutions, public Council-80 wording from internal architecture terminology, and production releases from staging candidates.
